conventions.coordinates: TileEntity NBT still requires ordinary 1.7 x/y/z fields; they are omitted from field lists below because the Backporter supplies block position generically.
conventions.item_stack: Item fields use normal Minecraft 1.7 ItemStack NBT after the Backporter translates source item IDs/components into target items.
unsupported_global: waterlogged unless an entry explicitly documents an existing EFR extension
conventions.unsupported_banner_patterns: Any modern pattern identifier absent from banner_pattern_to_legacy_id must be dropped or resolved by Backporter policy; EFR cannot render it exactly.

fields.name: Items
fields.note: Up to six ItemStack compounds; each carries Slot byte 0..5.

fields.name: OccupancyMask
fields.note: Bits 0..5 correspond to modern slot_0_occupied..slot_5_occupied. If an occupied bit has no translated item, EFR creates a placeholder minecraft:book.

fields.name: LastInteractedSlot
fields.note: -1 means legacy/never interacted; Backporter maps modern last_interacted_slot 0..5 directly.

source_properties.slot_0_occupied..slot_5_occupied: exact -> OccupancyMask; slot order is visual top-left, top-mid, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-mid, bottom-right when viewed from the block front

exactness.block_entity_display: exact when source items are translatable
exactness.behaviour: comparator output is LastInteractedSlot+1 (1..6), or 0 for -1; click-to-slot mapping is front-relative for all four facings

fields.name: Age
fields.note: Canonical Pass 32 age, clamped 0..25.

fields.name: MaxLength
fields.note: Legacy EFR compatibility only; importer may omit it. EFR defaults it safely and writes it back.

fields.name: TipSheared
fields.note: Legacy EFR behaviour flag; importer normally writes false unless preserving an EFR-origin map.

exactness.behaviour: natural growth increments Age and stops at 25; legacy MaxLength/TipSheared saves remain readable

unsupported: age (modern plant body has no age)
